title: Theranos CEO Elizabeth Holmes: Firing Back At Doubters | Mad Money | CNBC
summary: A 2015 CNBC Mad Money interview in which Jim Cramer gives Theranos CEO Elizabeth Holmes a platform to answer accusations about her company after critical press coverage. It captures her public persona at the height of the company's hype.
why: HN uses it as a primary source on Holmes's responses and, later, as evidence of her manner and voice.

quote.text: In this video she is being interviewed on Mad Money, using her (assumed) actual voice.
